title: Organization-wide delegation
description: Publish shared agent profiles and delegate scoped work into issue triage.

title: Founder
description: Ship changes locally as a human-authenticated founder agent, with optional worktree isolation and adversarial review.

title: Engineer
description: Research, implement, review, and merge changes locally through a human-authenticated engineering agent.

title: Software factory
description: Delegate typed issues to resident agents for CI-gated implementation, adversarial review, and automatic merge.

title: Adversarial review
description: Assign a distinct review agent to inspect a change and return an approval or actionable findings.

title: Bug issue
description: Investigate a fix issue and assign the resulting coding work to a resident agent.

title: Issue triage
description: Classify untyped issues and route features, fixes, and research into their delivery workflows.

title: Research triage
description: Classify research requests and route them into market, technical, or business investigation tracks.

title: Grafana alert investigation
description: Investigate a Grafana alert, create a fix issue, and hand it to issue triage.

title: Persona review
description: Review website changes, documents, and other artifacts from a selected persona's perspective, then save a sourced report.
